changelog:
Initial release of the Document Signing Setup Assistant.

- Provides step-by-step guidance for preparing and sending documents in Nota Sign.
- Helps users choose between one-off envelopes and templates based on document frequency.
- Offers best practices for adding signers, placing fields, configuring signing order, and reviewing before send.
- Recommends practical output formats such as checklists, setup steps, and field/signature mapping tables.
- Includes advice for tracking document status and managing audit records after sending.
summary: Help users set up document signing in Nota Sign. Use this skill when the user needs practical guidance for creating envelopes, adding signers, placing fields...
